query:
SELECT
                h.host_name,
                h.asset_criticality,
                h.is_server,
                h.expected_services,
                t.ip_address
            FROM host_behavior_baselines h
            LEFT JOIN targets t ON t.hostname = h.host_name OR t.ip_address::TEXT = h.host_name
            WHERE h.host_name = $1
            LIMIT 1
